candidates.description: This feature vector represents common suffixes and name components across multiple languages.
This vector represents a multilingual collection of disjointed subword tokens and noise.
This vector represents a sequence of closely related numeric values, predominantly centered around the mid-180s.
This feature represents grammatical markers and high-frequency function words, particularly possessive particles and prepositions across various languages, predominantly Thai and Romance languages.
This feature detects the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (So Suea) appearing as a sub-word token or suffix across various contexts.
This vector represents common Thai linguistic suffixes, prefixes, and syllable components used in word formation.
This feature vector activates strongly on the French liquid lateral approximant letter 'l' and common letter sequences containing it.
This feature vector activates on French words, names, and linguistic fragments starting with the letters "E" or "M".
This feature vector activates on tokens containing specific phonemes or spelling patterns associated with French names and vowel sounds.
This feature vector detects common morphological suffixes and linguistic endings across multiple natural languages.
